description.value: Kwong Chow Congee & Noodle House is a long-standing authentic Cantonese restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street, serving an extensive menu of congee, noodle soups, sizzling hot pots, and classic stir-fries. It is a full sit-down establishment with online ordering and quick 15-minute pickup, making it a practical stop for cyclists wanting a hearty Cantonese meal. The menu spans everything from deep-fried salt-and-pepper dishes to signature Kwong Chow Chicken.
